definition: I. גַּת noun feminine wine-press (contracted from * גַּנְתְּ = * יְגַּנְתְּ ) — absolute גַּת Judg 6:11 + 3 t.; גִּתּוֺת Neh 13:15 — wine-press , literal חֹבֵט חִטִּים בַגַּת Judg 6:11 beating out wheat in the wine-press , to hide it from Midian; the juice of the grapes was pressed out by treading, דֹּרֵךְ בְּגַ֑ת Isa 63:2 (in simile), but also as accusative דֹּרְכִים גִּתּוֺת Neh 13:15 in figure of judgment, ׳ גַּת דָּרַךְ אֲדֹנָי לִבְתּוּלַת וגו Lam 1:15 a wine-press hath Adonay trodden for the virgin daughter of Judah ; also רְדוּ כִּי מָֽלְאָה גַּת Joel 4:13 ( רדה only here with גַּת ). — On the form and use of wine-press, and Hebrew synonyms, see Smith DB (article wine-press ) Benz Archaeology 212 f. Rob BR iii, 137 Schick ZPV x, 1887, 146, 150, and Plural see vii. Anderlind ZPV xi, 1888, 166 f .
